answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind one hardware-attested key: one key, one identity, and the stake is slashed if that key ever signs twice. A Sybil farmer must pay a fresh deposit for every fake agent, the way a forge must heat a fresh ferrous blank for each blade — a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes, and honest agents get the deposit back. Each key sits at a single vertex of the trust graph, so one exposed shared key collapses the whole ring at once, and a real identity holds value by being one of a kind.
